description: Defines template classes and functions for creating and managing dynamic and static types within the c10 namespace, including type factories for c10::DynamicType and c10::Type, with platform-specific type aliasing.

classes.name: TypeFactoryBase
classes.description: Template class for creating type factories for different type categories.

classes.name: TypeFactoryBase<c10::DynamicType>
classes.description: Specialization of TypeFactoryBase for c10::DynamicType, providing methods to create dynamic types.

classes.name: TypeFactoryBase<c10::Type>
classes.description: Specialization of TypeFactoryBase for c10::Type, providing methods to create static types.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a DynamicType or Type with given parameters.

methods.name: createNamedTuple
methods.description: Creates a named tuple DynamicType with specified name, fields, and types.

methods.name: createNamed
methods.description: Creates a named DynamicType or Type with specified name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the base type for a given type T.

methods.name: dynT
methods.description: Helper function to construct DynamicTypePtr for base or non-base types.
